verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is software you run on your own infrastructure. Evidence shows it is written in C, runs on Linux, Windows and macOS, and can be built from source with configure options (Q8 non-HDRI, 64-channel masks). Docs cover tailoring security policies to your own server environment. Community reports corroborate this: users run it on Heroku, ship it inside their own SaaS on Windows, and are advised to make their own builds. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence.
